items.title: AI News Today — Latest AI Announcements, Model Releases ...
items.summary: Meta AI Research released Muse Spark Open on Oct 15, 2026 – a multimodal mixture‑of‑experts model with 816 billion total parameters (42 billion active) and a 1 million‑token context window. The model is open‑weight, hosted on Hugging Face, SageMaker, Google Cloud Model Garden and Microsoft Foundry, with inference services on Baseten, Fireworks, Groq, Modal, Nebius, OpenRouter and Together, and can run on a desktop using two Apple M5 Ultra Macs. items.summary: The AI News Hub reports several concrete developments: NVIDIA unveiled a 2.8‑trillion‑token Indic pretraining corpus and open data pipeline; Anthropic moved its Claude Code Review tool to general availability with up to $50,000 in free credits for enterprises; Meta released Muse Spark Open, an 816‑billion‑parameter multimodal model supporting text, image, video, and audio with up to one‑million‑token context. items.title: 6 Parallelism Strategies for LLM Inference in Production
items.summary: The article explains six parallelism strategies—data, tensor, pipeline, context, expert, and hybrid—for scaling LLM inference in production, detailing trade‑offs and when to use each. It also introduces an open‑source router (HarnessRouter) that unifies agent harnesses and a schema‑guided memory approach using Pydantic‑typed entities and the Zep Graphiti library.
items.why: Provides concrete engineering guidance to efficiently run LLMs and build scalable agents.

items.title: Xplore-LAB/llm-tracker: 大模型情报局 - GitHub
items.summary: Xplore‑LAB’s llm‑tracker is a GitHub‑hosted static site that automatically fetches new arXiv LLM papers, classifies them into eight themes, and generates Chinese one‑sentence notes using an LLM. The pipeline runs daily via GitHub Actions and offers searchable tables, company‑specific columns, and optional PDF links.
items.why: Provides an automated way to stay current with the flood of LLM research papers.

items.title: A Production-Grade, High-Efficiency Agentic RL Framework for ...
items.summary: A recent paper presents a lean 14,000‑line production‑grade framework for training high‑efficiency agentic reinforcement‑learning LLMs, aiming to simplify the development of frontier LLM agents.
items.why: Offers a ready‑to‑use codebase that can accelerate building and training LLM agents for engineers.
